observed_mechanics: Read the stack word at ESP+0x04 into EAX and keep ECX in ESI.
Compare ESI with EAX; on equality jump to the epilogue and return without touching state.
Form the source map address other+0x18 in EDI and the destination map address this+0x18 in EBX.
Push the source map address, set ECX to the destination map, and call 0x006a1e80 (the runtime-gated map-copy port).
Read the byte at source_map+0x14 into AL and store it at destination_map+0x14.
Read this+0x30, push it, set ECX back to this, and call 0x006a1710 (SetParent).
